parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center region based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are located in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are located outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view.
